Stick length = Novi's ll_ft (geodesic stick length where ll_ft is missing). Under the r2 selection of record (D121) a location's length never selects analogs: analogs are 5,000–15,000-ft completed laterals and the cohort is ALWAYS Cui-translated to the location (box/analog.Rules, lateral='translate'). So a long Midland PUD is not denied analogs — it is translated on the Delaware WCA Cui & Cross curve, extrapolated past 12,500 ft (E(20,000 ft) ≈ 0.714 vs 5,000 ft) — and Midland producers longer than 15,000 ft are excluded from every analog pool.

8. Terminal decline Df (decision d)

On 3,000 oil fits of the live record run 19 (Delaware, sampled by md5 of location_id), swapping the terminal Df from 0.08 to 0.06 /yr with the same qi / Di / b changes the 50-yr EUR by a median 4.7 % (P10 3.4 %, P90 6.3 %). Df is the in-house Midland value (CLAUDE.md sub-basin terminal decline: Midland 0.06, otherwise 0.08); box/analog.DF_DELAWARE = 0.08 is hard-coded on every fit path.
